integration tests pass with zero schema validation failures across all microservices.", "output": "Please verify the gRPC protocol buffer schema definitions in proto/service.proto before running code generation. We need to check userSessionToken and account_identifier in the authentication response message. Ensure that buf.gen.yaml generates TypeScript client interfaces into src/client.ts and Golang server stubs into server/server.go with --dry-run enabled to catch compilation errors. In the Protobuf service declaration, verify that GetUserAccount RPC method specifies deadline timeouts of 500 milliseconds and uses max_retry_attempts set to 3 in the client retry policy metadata. The Golang implementation in server.go must enforce context cancellation when client connections abort mid-stream and verify that connection pool workers do not leak memory during high-volume bidirectional streaming. Also check that error status codes map cleanly to grpc.codes.Unauthenticated rather than returning internal server error. The frontend integration in client.ts requires strict TypeScript type checking with --strict flag and must handle reconnection backoff gracefully using exponential backoff starting at 50 milliseconds up to 2 seconds. The protocol buffer enum definitions for user roles must declare ROLE_UNSPECIFIED as the default zero value to ensure backwards compatibility. Inspect gateway.conf to verify that gRPC-Web proxy rules route browser requests cleanly to port 9090. Client applications must also handle trailers containing structured error details including error reason, domain, and metadata key-value pairs. Verify that the Rust client stubs generated into client/lib.rs compile with cargo check --all-targets. The continuous integration workflow in .github/workflows/proto.yaml must run code generation automatically on pull requests. Ensure that generated files include DO NOT EDIT header comments and maintain deterministic field ordering across Protobuf messages. In addition, benchmark the serialization overhead using go test --bench . to confirm allocations remain below 1 kilobyte per call. The API gateway team must approve any field number deprecations in accordance with our backward compatibility governance protocol. Network security policies must also enforce mutual TLS on port 9091 using certificates generated by cert-manager.io. Service health checks must expose the standard gRPC health checking protocol version 1 on port 8080. Finally, verify that docker-compose.yaml mounts the generated Protobuf definitions into the staging container environment and confirm that synthetic integration tests pass with zero schema validation failures across all microservices."}]
